discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 53abfc28. Unsupported fallback targets now return `None` rather than presenting UTC as local wall-clock time.

Good catch on the contradiction, but I fixed it the other way round: the docs were wrong, not the code.

Every other integration in `targets.rs` treats a missing config directory as "the agent is not installed" and refuses:

```
"{agent} config directory not found at {}. install {agent} first"
```

That holds for claude, codex, copilot, devin, droid, kimi, opencode, kilo, hermes, qodercli, cursor, mastracode and grok. Creating `~/.gemini/config` on demand would make `herdr integration install antigravity-cli` silently succeed on a machine with no Antigravity CLI, writing hooks nothing will ever read.

So in f71ca5ef the guard stays and the docs line now reads "must already exist", matching the Grok wording. Added `install_antigravity_cli_errors_when_config_dir_missing`, which also asserts install does not create the directory.

Note the path itself changed to `~/.gemini/config` in the same commit, since that is where agy actually reads global hooks from.

This is intentional. The WMI serialization API cannot faithfully carry an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate. Silently dropping that inherited entry would give panes a different environment, while direct spawning here is known to die at SSH logout. Failing before launch preserves the durability and full-environment contract instead of starting a subtly broken session.
